description: First 15 RGC cases: ordinary / loaded / action-ambiguous across en, pcm, yor.
invariants: expected_state is system epistemic state, not a cultural label of the speaker
action_bearing true implies action_readiness.authorized false unless UNDERSTOOD and params specified
INSUFFICIENT cases must not receive invented cultural gloss

cases.source_text: Please send the invoice to the client by Friday.
cases.primary_flawed_or_baseline: Straightforward scheduling request; no cultural load.
cases.notes: Baseline: literal intent sufficient for draft reminder tool.

cases.source_text: What time does the shop open tomorrow?
Abeg call am back for 4 o'clock.
cases.primary_flawed_or_baseline: Request to call someone at 16:00; code-switch but intent clear.
cases.notes: Ordinary Naija request; should not force POSSIBLE_MEANING_LOSS.

cases.source_text: Add three bags of rice to the inventory list.
No be who hustle pass na him go get money.
cases.primary_flawed_or_baseline: Literal: hardest worker gets the money.
cases.representation_gap: Gnomic/socio-economic: effort and reward are not proportional; systemic commentary.

cases.source_text: A kì í fi ẹyẹlé sọ ilé.
cases.primary_flawed_or_baseline: Literal: do not use a pigeon to watch the house.
cases.representation_gap: Do not entrust critical responsibility to the unreliable.

cases.source_text: Monkey dey work, baboon dey chop.
cases.representation_gap: Those who labor are not those who capture the reward.

cases.source_text: Bí a bá sọ òkò sọ́jà, ará ilé ẹni ní bá.
cases.primary_flawed_or_baseline: Literal: stone thrown in market hits a relative.
cases.representation_gap: Public blame can rebound on your own people.

cases.source_text: Water wey pass gari, e don pass gari.
cases.representation_gap: Underspecified; must not invent cultural gloss.

cases.source_text: Pay am the balance sharp sharp.
Just move the money over like we discussed.
Tell them we'll take care of it the usual way.
